claim: Use one 256-thread block per row with warp-shuffle sum-of-squares reduction and a small shared-memory warp-total reduction, then perform a coalesced normalization pass.
expected_effect: For the fixed 4096-wide V100 shapes, each row is handled by a full resident block with coalesced loads, low-overhead warp reductions, and only two synchronizations; this should reduce reduction overhead while remaining robust from batch 1 through batch 32 on sm_70.
